evidence: Official site confirmed at https://www.bridgeport.edu (126 Park Avenue, Bridgeport, CT 06604). PROGRAMS: catalog lists 57 program entries; the bridgeport.edu-sourced subset (Accounting BS, Analytics MS, AI MS, Biology BA/BS, Counseling MS, Data Analytics BS, Education Masters, English BS, Marketing BS, Mathematics, Medical Billing cert, Medical Sciences MS, Nutrition MS, Psychology, MPH, Sport Management) have valid working programUrl paths under /academics/programs/ and match real offerings. However the larger edvoy-sourced subset carries systematically wrong metadata (all level='bachelor' even for MS/PhD, all durationYears=3, all intakes=September) and points programUrl to edge.edvoy.com aggregator, not UB. UB advertises 'over 80 in-demand programs'; catalog has fewer and with duplicates, so programs are real-but-stale. PRICES: tuition.byProgram is empty {}; official 2025-2026 undergraduate tuition is $16,430/semester ($32,860/yr) + $1,500/sem general fee + $120/sem student gov fee + $200 orientation (~$36,300/yr total); part-time $1,095/credit. None of this is in the catalog -> absent. CAMPUSES: catalog lists one 'Bridgeport Main Campus' which matches UB's single main campus at 126 Park Ave -> accurate. SCHOLARSHIPS: not present in catalog (requirements/deadlines empty); UB offers international academic scholarships $5,000-$20,000/yr (tuition only), auto-considered -> absent from catalog. ACCOMMODATION: not present in catalog at all; UB has on-campus residence halls -> absent. Sources: https://www.bridgeport.edu/academics/programs/ ; https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid/tuition-fees/undergraduate ; https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/international/faq (scholarships).
